description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for sentinel-bevy (NEURAL DEFENSE, Rust + Bevy) — complex regression patterns from deep code review

rules.name: Rust: panic in config loading path
rules.message: Config/setup function contains panic path — missing or malformed files will crash the game. Return Result and handle gracefully.
rules.suggestion: Change load_ron_file to return Result<Config, LoadError> and propagate errors to a fallback screen.

rules.name: Rust: Asset handle reuse across enemy types
rules.message: Same asset handle assigned to different enemy types — enemies are visually indistinguishable. Load dedicated assets per type.
rules.suggestion: Load a separate texture for each enemy type, or use an enum + match to select distinct assets.

rules.name: Rust: Relative path literal in file open without absolute resolution
rules.message: File operation with relative path resolves against CWD. Use absolute paths from dirs crate for config/assets.

rules.name: Rust: Bevy system with unwrap() on resource query
rules.message: unwrap() on Bevy resource/query in a system will panic if the resource is missing. Use Res<T> with proper error handling.
rules.suggestion: Accept the resource as Res<T> (returns None if absent) or use Option<Res<T>> and handle the None case.
